| Worst MDD | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

## Status: ✅ Healthy

- **Champion retained** — better tuning stability and lower drawdown
- **Candidate archived** — improved lockbox min but higher tail risk
- **No inconclusive runs** pending
- **~26 hours remaining** in runloop budget

## Recommended Actions

```bash
# Execute provided commands in sequence
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Notes for Next Session
- Monitor fold14 specifically — both configs show ~9-10% MDD there
- Candidate's tuning_min of 0.051 suggests fragility in one fold worth investigating
- Loop count 209 indicates healthy iteration velocity (~9.4 loops/hour)

Ready to continue when runloop resumes or if intervention needed.
